_doc: How tools/audio.py drives Space Invaders' sound engine. RAM names come from ram.inc. A sound is started the way VBlank does it: its number in entry 1 of wSoundQueue, wSoundQueueEnd = 1, wSoundQueuePos = 0, then PlayQueuedSound. The engine itself runs in the timer interrupt (TimerHandler, about 60 times a second: 4096 Hz / 68); it reads rNR52 to see which channels have fallen silent, so the APU's channel status is put there before every tick. A sound plays while bit 0 of any channel record's flags (+1) is set.

music 24: ShowLinkWin: the link game is won
music 25: ShowLinkLoss: the link game is lost
music 28: SndUnusedTune: three channels, but no code requests it
sfx 5: MoveCannonAndFire (sounds $05-$07: left, middle, right of the screen)
sfx 8: CheckShotHitsInvader (sounds $08-$0A by the side of the screen)
sfx 12: SpawnUfo: it loops for as long as the UFO is on screen (sounds $0C-$0E by side)
sfx 18: UpdateUfoHit; in a link game when the opponent is hit
sfx 20: PlayMarchStep: the four march notes, one per step of the formation
